title: Notes Left on the Shelf
story: Nadia had to give a short history talk after lunch. She prepared pictures of an old bridge and put them in a yellow folder. At noon she revised in the library and left the folder on a low shelf. When the bell rang, she walked to class without it. Her friend Omar sent a message to say the folder was still there. Nadia asked the teacher for a later turn and hurried back. The librarian had moved the folder to the front desk. Nadia checked the pictures, thanked her, and returned to class. She spoke after the break, and the class could see the bridge clearly. The teacher said the talk was calm and easy to follow. That evening she clipped the folder inside her school bag. She also set a reminder on her phone for the next talk. She did not want to leave her notes behind again.
